purpose: Screen the seven binomial labels printed in Vedra et al.'s 2024 Claver river/estuary survey against fish-name authorities, retaining source spellings and separating nomenclature from specimen identification and station-level occurrence.

authority.institution: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.catalogVersion: Catalog overview version dated 20 October 2026; some indexed taxon excerpts show entry update dates in August 2026. Alepes melanoptera was checked in ITIS, whose record cites the Catalog version of 2 April 2024.
authority.accessMethod: Official Eschmeyer Catalog taxon/genus records were reviewed via indexed official pages where direct retrieval was unavailable. Fibramia lateralis was cross-checked against WoRMS and NCBI Taxonomy; Alepes melanoptera against ITIS, which records the Catalog as its name source. No access controls were bypassed.
authority.reuse: No item-specific republication terms for the Catalog or nomenclature services were verified. Only concise attributed name-status summaries and source links are retained.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: Candidate current-combination crosswalk only. WoRMS and NCBI Taxonomy treat Apogon lateralis Valenciennes, 1832 as a basionym/synonym under Fibramia lateralis; an earlier combination Ostorhinchus lateralis is also recorded. The printed source form is preserved.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Nomenclature only. The paper supplies no taxon-to-station or specimen voucher crosswalk, and this name resolution does not identify its photographed/captured fish.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: Valid as printed in Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Name status only. The source does not establish the fish's identity, origin, introduction pathway, station or waterbody.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: Valid as printed in Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Name status only. No specimen identification, local establishment, introduction pathway or station is verified.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: Valid as printed in Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Name status only. No specimen identification or connection to a named river, estuary, station or salinity condition is verified.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: The Catalog lists Siganus javus as valid. The source label `jarvus` was not silently corrected; `javus` is a candidate spelling crosswalk pending source/specimen review.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Possible source spelling error only. Nomenclatural lookup does not identify the fish or its site.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: The Catalog lists Terapon jarbua as valid. The printed `jarboa` form is preserved; `jarbua` is a candidate spelling crosswalk, not a specimen re-identification.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Possible source spelling error only. No station or voucher assignment is established.

nameCrosswalk.catalogOutcome: ITIS records the name as valid and cites Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes (2 April 2024) as its source; the California Academy Catalog recognizes Alepes as a valid genus. This is a bounded name-status confirmation, not an independent identification.
nameCrosswalk.localityFlag: Name status only. No specimen identification or site assignment is verified.

interpretation.nomenclature: Three source forms have candidate current-name or spelling crosswalks: Apogon lateralis to Fibramia lateralis, Siganus jarvus to Siganus javus, and Terapon jarboa to Terapon jarbua. Four other binomials are valid as printed in the checked references.
interpretation.specimenIdentity: No voucher accession, repository specimen, or photo-to-taxon/site chain of custody was independently verified. A name-status crosswalk cannot establish that the paper's fish were correctly identified.
interpretation.locality: The article has a Claver, Surigao del Norte versus Surigao del Sur table-caption conflict, and Table 4 has no station/waterbody column. No taxon is assigned to any individual creek, river, estuary or station.
interpretation.partialLabels: Cyprinidae sp., Lethrinus sp., Holocentrus sp. and Sargocentrus sp. remain unresolved at the family/genus label level; no species-level inference was attempted.
interpretation.otherClaims: No current presence, natural diet, legal access, catchability, current water safety, geometry or public-app claim was added.

limitations: Accepted names and candidate spelling/combination crosswalks do not verify historical fish identifications.
The source article gives no station-level fish crosswalk and has a Claver, Surigao del Norte versus Surigao del Sur caption conflict.
Four labels remain family/genus-only and cannot be counted as identified species.
ITIS's Alepes melanoptera entry cites the Catalog version of 2 April 2024; it is not a direct 2026 species-record confirmation.
No local presence, abundance, diet, safety, legal or catchability conclusion is supported by this taxonomy-only screen.
nextAction: Keep the 11 paper fish labels and four partial labels research-only. Seek any independently published correction, voucher accession or station-to-photo/specimen crosswalk before assigning taxa to Claver waterbodies; do not contact authors or infer current presence without separate authorization/evidence.
